Description: [Raid Teleporters] Captain America Ally - Age of Ultron teleporter (replaces Domino, whose model wasn't cooked into the client UPKs - Domino/Manifold/Songbird all confirmed missing client-side despite valid server data). This is real, cut Civil War Ally content - has a genuine cooked model since she was used in an actual escort/ally fight sequence, unlike the fully-cut NPCs tried before. Native BehaviorProfile.Brain points at an active combat AI profile (CaptainAmericaProfileFriendly) that would make her wander/aggro in the hub like the boss/ally she was built as - nulled out to make her passive/idle like Cloak (whose BehaviorProfile has no Brain set at all).

[Raid Teleporters] Native Alliance is Players.prototype (a full combat ally - hostile to enemies, friendly to players, with WhileConfused/WhileControlled overrides) since she was built to fight alongside players. Repointed to the same Entity/Alliances/NPCNeutral.prototype Cloak uses, so she doesn't try to engage anything in the hub.
[Raid Teleporters] Native Allegiance is None - set to Neutral to match Cloak/Misty Knight/Doctor Strange's pattern.

[Raid Teleporters] Age of Ultron teleporter - place Captain America Ally at this marker slot (previously Domino, removed - see BehaviorProfile.Brain patch above for why). Marker 0's native LastKnownEntityName was SpawnMarkers/Types/EncounterTinyV3.prototype - a generic encounter spawn placeholder, same reusable category as markers 30/31/32 (already repurposed for the EG Patrol teleporters), not a fixed named NPC.
[Raid Teleporters] Age of Ultron teleporter - final placement position in Avengers Tower, confirmed live.

[Raid Teleporters] Age of Ultron teleporter - rotation zeroed out per the same convention as the EG Patrol teleporters, so the correct final rotation can be judged fresh from a known (0,0,0) baseline.

Native DesignState is NotInGame - flip to Live. Confirmed safe to reuse: 0 prototype-data references anywhere in the game, 0 cell-marker placements anywhere.
